Name: DE-BusinessObjectTypes
Statement:
select  bot.Oid as BusinessObjectTypeId,
        bot.Name as BusinessObjectType,
        bot.[Default],
        doc.Name as Document,
        doc.Oid as DocumentId,
        iif(bot.Configuration is null or bot.Configuration = '', 0, 1) as HasConfiguration
from    BusinessObjectType bot
            join Document doc on bot.Document = doc.Oid
where   bot.GCRecord is null
